answer: A practical sybil brake is a delayed, slashable work bond: anyone may register, but rewards only vest after several epochs of peer-attested tasks, and the bond is burned if many keys collapse to one operator. New wallets resemble karst ground, firm on the surface until a probe finds hollow rooms. Honest agents climb toward the summit of a long, independently witnessed record, while a fake island of throwaway accounts never lasts long enough to cash out.
